mesh.definition: Require three actual mesh levels and three actual time resolutions. Compare medium to finest for every retained solid region; a reference rise below the absolute floor does not establish accurate tiny coupling signals. Thresholds are engineering screens, not an observed formal asymptotic order or calibrated temperature error.

radiation_facets_fine.definition: Common time window. Temperature policy plus net-radiation energy difference <= max(0.1 J, 5% reference). Includes changed heat convergence tolerance where applicable. Engineering screen, not calibrated error.

radiation_facets_medium.definition: Common time window. Temperature policy plus net-radiation energy difference <= max(0.1 J, 5% reference). Includes changed heat convergence tolerance where applicable. Engineering screen, not calibrated error.

radiation_facets_combined.definition: Common time window. Temperature policy plus net-radiation energy difference <= max(0.1 J, 5% reference). Includes changed heat convergence tolerance where applicable. Engineering screen, not calibrated error.
